descriptor: Arcade Connect Four against the computer

voice.summary: Drop Four sounds like a friendly arcade rival: quick banter, big short words and a grin when you lose. Every line is built to be read at a glance mid-game.
dos: Keep banter to six words or fewer
Announce turns and results in bold, plain verbs
Tease the player, never the effort
donts: Use gamer slang that will date

taglines: Four in a row, no excuses
boilerplate: Drop Four is a browser Connect Four with a minimax computer opponent, three difficulty levels and a two-player mode, built for quick rounds and playful rivalry.

microcopy.success: Four in a row! You win.
microcopy.empty: Board is clear. Drop a disc.

logo.note: A falling disc is the one gesture the whole game is built on.
